program.name: Back & Hips
program.subject: Back care
program.blurb: Back care through the hips: a hip flow and glute circuit one day, spine movement and trunk strength the next.
program.about: Back care that starts at the hips, because stiff hips and sleepy glutes often load the lower back. One day is a hip mobility flow followed by a glute circuit; the other is spine movement followed by trunk strength. Calm pace throughout. Level II adds reps and Level III brings slightly harder versions. Stop if anything sharpens pain.
